definitions.call_opportunity: A dahai state whose huro map contains LuckyJ's seat; the dahai state's msg.pai is the triggering discard.
definitions.actual_call: The next state's msg is chi, pon, or daiminkan with actor equal to LuckyJ's seat.
definitions.turn: len(discards[LuckyJ]) + 1 before adding the triggering discard.
definitions.shanten: Regular-hand shanten of LuckyJ's current concealed tiles using mahjong.shanten.Shanten and counts_34; open melds are implied, chiitoitsu/kokushi disabled.
definitions.dora_count: Dora in LuckyJ's current concealed hand from visible dora indicators, plus one for each red five; red fives also count normal dora if the dora tile is five.
definitions.yakuhai: Dragons plus round wind and LuckyJ's seat wind via build_point_examples.yakuhai_for_seat().
definitions.first_discarded_copy: No previous discard of the same tile type in any player's discard list before the triggering discard.
definitions.rank_split: Score rank is read from the kyoku start seat2rank; only 1st and 4th are included in the requested split.

definitions.included: Discard is yakuhai for LuckyJ, LuckyJ holds at least two of that tile in the concealed hand, and huro options contain kind 4 (pon).
definitions.pon_rate_pct: Next state is pon by LuckyJ divided by included opportunities.
definitions.called_any_rate_pct: Next state is chi, pon, or daiminkan by LuckyJ divided by included opportunities.

definitions.population: Same yakuhai pon opportunities as yakuhai_pon_rate.
definitions.first_discarded_copy: The triggering discard is the first discarded copy of that tile type seen in any river.
definitions.later_copy: At least one same-type copy was already discarded before the triggering discard.

definitions.included: huro options for LuckyJ contain any chi kind (1, 2, or 3).
definitions.chi_rate_pct: Next state is chi by LuckyJ divided by included opportunities.
definitions.fully_closed: LuckyJ has no prior open chi/pon/daiminkan meld before the opportunity; closed kan is not counted as open.
definitions.already_open: LuckyJ already has at least one prior open chi/pon/daiminkan meld before the opportunity.

definitions.included: All LuckyJ huro call opportunities with left_hai_num <= 12.
definitions.call_rate_pct: Next state is chi, pon, or daiminkan by LuckyJ divided by included opportunities.

definitions.junk_hand: LuckyJ has regular-hand shanten >= 4 and zero dora in the concealed hand at a call opportunity.
definitions.all_call_opportunities: All huro call opportunities matching junk_hand.
definitions.yakuhai_pon_opportunities: Subset that also matches the yakuhai pon opportunity definition.

proposed_rules: Default to ponning yakuhai pairs: LuckyJ poned 75.0% (n=2915) overall.
Pon the first visible yakuhai copy rather than waiting: first-copy pon rate 76.9% (n=2618) vs later-copy 58.2% (n=297).
Use shanten as the main brake on yakuhai pon: 0-1 shanten 63.0% (n=694), 2-3 shanten 78.8% (n=1807), 4+ shanten 78.7% (n=414).
Do not make chi your first call lightly: closed-to-open chi rate 6.8% (n=21615); once already open, chi rate 27.4% (n=3837).
In the last 12 tiles, call for keiten at 1-shanten: call rate 31.9% (n=627) vs 2+ shanten 20.7% (n=798).
Treat 4+ shanten, 0-dora hands as junk: pass all call chances 85.9% (n=1691); yakuhai pon still happens only 72.4% (n=210).
Let dora increase yakuhai-pon willingness: 0 dora 71.6% (n=1263), 1 dora 76.0% (n=1107), 2+ dora 81.1% (n=545).
